SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY CAPE MAY COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT SHERIFF'S SALE NO.
26000436 DOCKET NO. F-006905-26
PLAINTIFF – FINANCE OF AMERICA REVERSE LLC
DEFENDANTS- VICKII LYNN WILLIAMS, ET A
L By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to
me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on Wednesday THE 3rd DAY OF March 2027 At 1:00 o'clock in the afternoon at the old Courthouse building located at 9 N Main Street (Route 9), in Cape May Court House, New Jersey to wit: All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the TOWNSHIP OF MIDDLE of Cape May Court House, County of Cape May and State of New Jersey: Being known as: LOT 4, BLOCK 264 Dimensions of Lot: 100 feet wide by 160 feet long Nearest Cross Street: E 4th Avenue. OWNER OCCUPIED
Estimated Upset Bid Amount: $282,000.00.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS: 208 E ATLANTIC Avenue Cape May Court House, NJ 08210
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Cape May County Sheriff. Lien(s)/Taxes: 2027 Qtr 1 Due: 2/1/2027 $1,377.52 OPEN, 2027 Qtr 2 Due: 5/1/2027 $1,377.51 OPEN Sewer: Middle Twp. Sewer Dept 33 Mechanic Street Cape May Court House, NJ 08210 609-465-8724, Acct: 5009 0 10/1/2026- 12/31/2026 $190.00 OPEN PLUS PENALTY Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Cape May County Sheriff Office. Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon. If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney. Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking conducting
the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any. The approximate amount due on this execution is $259,009.82 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Robert A. Nolan, SHERIFF DATED: November 9, 2026
Ras Citron, LLC 130 Clinton Road, Suite 202
Fairfield, NJ 07004
